summary.text: Annette McRae is the Utah Forward Party candidate for the Utah State Senate, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Ronald Winterton.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Utah small-business owner and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: McRae said in her Ballotpedia survey that she is running because too many public decisions are made in isolation, creating long-term risks for families, workers and communities.
She said her work focuses on connecting transportation, housing, water, energy and air quality, and that she supports passenger rail, water reuse and responsible energy planning.
McRae named public safety, water conservation, housing affordability and constitutional governance among the policy areas she cares about most.
